**Type:** periodical

## Description

This periodical, the privately printed journal of the Society of Watchers and Workers, ran 1880-1972; the BL has only odd volumes, but there is an almost complete run in Lambeth Palace Library.  The BL's copies are bound with interesting rolls of members of the society;  CMY is listed as a member of the executive committee.  Christina Rossetti was also a member.  The <i>Watchword</i> was initially edited by the society’s founder [Edith Jacob](../people/person_749.qmd) (1836-1918).
